scripts.format:check: prettier --check src test scripts public package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write src test scripts public package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs
scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc && node dist/scripts/build-assets.js
scripts.openapi:docs: npm run openapi:generate && redocly build-docs openapi.json --output documentation/index.html
